text.p: First Union Corp said Thursday it completed the acquisition of Keystone Investments Inc, a Boston-based investment management firm.

First Union said that as previously announced in September, it will issue approximately 2,912,000 shares of common stock to the holders of Keystone common stock and account for the transaction as a pooling of interests.
Keystone Investments has $11.7 billion in assets under management.

The First Union-advised Evergreen Funds, together with the Keystone mutual fund family, create a mutual fund complex with $30 billion in assets under management and 70 funds, First Union said. The new fund family will be called the Evergreen Keystone Funds. Currently, it said Evergreen is one of the fastest growing fund families in the industry, with 35 funds and more than $18 billion in assets under management.
First Union shares closed Wednesday at 74-3/4.
